dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. Can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn. kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I bought these jeans here on Sunday, but they're too tight.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈbɔːt ðiːz ˈdʒiːnz ˈhɪr ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ, bʌt ðɛr ˈtuː ˈtaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. Would you like to exchange them for a bigger size?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ðɛm fər ə ˈbɪɡər ˈsaɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I tried a bigger size, but it was too loose.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈtraɪd ə ˈbɪɡər ˈsaɪz, bʌt ɪt wʌz ˈtuː ˈluːs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How about a different style? These jeans are very popular.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈstaɪl? ðiːz ˈdʒiːnz ər ˈvɛri ˈpɑːpjələr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, thanks. They're too expensive. Can I get a refund?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈθæŋks. ðɛr ˈtuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv. kən aɪ ˈɡɛt ə ˈriːfʌnd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you have your receipt?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. duː juː ˈhæv jʊr rɪˈsiːt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you. Here's your money: nine hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. hɪrz jʊr ˈmʌni: ˈnaɪn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.
